# Agent Organization Precheck — C0 Evidence Boundary

## Result

```ini
AGENT_ORGANIZATION_DESIGN_REFERENCE = EXISTS
AGENT_ORGANIZATION_RUNTIME_IMPLEMENTATION = NOT_ESTABLISHED
MULTI_AGENT_AUTONOMOUS_COORDINATION = FORBIDDEN
```

The historical 12-condition slice maps condition 7 to `Planner / Agent
Organization`.  That is `DOCUMENT`-strength architecture intent only.  It
does not prove a runtime scheduler, Agent lifecycle, shared State protocol,
delegation path, conflict policy, or independent Auditor separation.

V0.5's local external-Agent adapter is not a multi-Agent organizer.  It only
accepts one bounded request and explicitly prohibits multi-Agent autonomous
coordination.  The old Five-Body workbench is a read-only reference in this
audit; it is not imported, called, or bridged.

## Consequence

No Agent Organization remediation may be implemented until C2 yields a
candidate `CapabilityFeasibleSet`.  A future A0 audit must establish:

```text
role identity + required capability types + separation requirements
+ dependency graph + State isolation + budget allocation
+ conflict/retry/recovery rules + evidence/trace requirements
```

An A1 output may only be a `CandidateAgentOrganizationPlan`.  It must not
create Agents, allocate Authority, invoke a capability, or start execution.
